note: Fresh code audit of the uncommitted working tree on 24 Oct, replacing the pre-implementation audit (kept at superseded/audit-P5-pre.json). All P5 code (apps/api/src/{agile,time-tracking,kb,service-management,report,pages,customer-invitation}, migrations 0148-0154, 25 tests/api-integration/p5-*.test.ts, web components) is untracked/uncommitted and every P5 feature flag is default-off. implemented_tested = behaviour present in code AND a test asserts it; it does NOT mean an executed integration run: this audit ran no database, so the 25 P5 integration suites are cited as present, not run (no P5 integration run result was found in docs/report). Unit runs executed by this audit, 24 Oct 16:59, all green: U1 = API unit tests/api/{agile,kb,report,time-tracking} 5 files 110/110; U2 = web P5 components (agile, time-tracking, reports, kb, service-management, workflow/cab-template-panel) plus lib/report-search and lib/dashboard-layout, 31 files 158/158; U3 = packages/domain service-management 2 files 29/29. browser_verified is false for every item: scripted sign-in is blocked and no P5 screen was exercised in a browser. Not counted here: the requirements index assigns no CP, IP, VW or PG row to P5, and build-data counts only the 91 P5 ids. Unindexed ids (no row in docs/requirements-index.json in any phase, so they cannot be counted anywhere until rows are added): Pages PG-1..PG-8 (feature-contracts-p5.md) and the invitation ids CP-20..CP-29 and IP-35. Of these, PG-7 undelete is API-only (POST /projects/{projectId}/pages/{id}/undelete has no web caller), and CP-22/CP-26 limits are hard-coded in apps/api/src/customer-invitation/logic.ts CUSTOMER_INVITATION_LIMITS rather than instance configuration; lane claims about CP-24 and CP-27..29 were not re-verified. Indexed elsewhere and not re-verified here: CP-12, CP-17, CP-18, IP-9, IP-29 (P3) and VW-20 (P1).

top_gaps: Evidence: nothing in P5 is browser-verified (scripted sign-in blocked) and none of the 25 P5 integration suites was run by this audit; 69 implemented_tested items rest on unrun integration tests plus green unit runs. All P5 code is uncommitted.

Cost tracking: no cost types or cost entries (TC-12, TC-13, TC-14 missing), so budget actuals are time-only (TC-16), committed is always null (TC-17) and 75/90% thresholds raise no notification (TC-18).
Capacity: no available_hours (TC-20 missing); utilisation and the capacity report use team capacity_days_per_week instead (TC-21, TC-22).

Reports: no metric_snapshot or hourly job, every period is live (RP-9); no export for tier 3 custom reports or widgets and no queued large-export job (RP-10); drill-down exists on only 12 of 24 tier 1 reports (RP-12).

Knowledge base authoring: callouts and work item references cannot be inserted in the editor (KB-5, KB-6); owner not settable in the editor (KB-7); matching is a LIKE scan, not a full-text index (KB-9); related and most-viewed/recent ordering untested (KB-15, KB-16).
Change and release: CAB gating is an opt-in template, not the default (CH-2); low-risk pre-approval edge is not generated (CH-3); releases flagged for the portal have no portal surface (REL-5).
Velocity counts only cycles closed with the completion action; cycles that end by date have no snapshot and no daily snapshot job exists (CY-9).

Unindexed requirements: PG-1..8, CP-20..29 and IP-35 have contract ids but no row in docs/requirements-index.json, so no phase counts them; PG-7 undelete has no UI and CP-22/CP-26 invitation limits are hard-coded rather than instance configuration.
tonight_actions: Run the 25 tests/api-integration/p5-*.test.ts on a dedicated scratch _test database (never taskdesk_browser_journey_1022_test) and cite the run here before the P5 phase review.

Browser-verify P5 screens on persisted data once scripted sign-in is unblocked: cycles (drag from backlog, completion dialog), modules, estimates preview, timesheet/timer reload, budget, rates, reports and dashboards (drag/resize), KB editor and portal deflection, services, changes, freeze override, calendar, releases.
Build cost types and cost entries (TC-12..14) and then committed (TC-17) and the 75/90% notification (TC-18), or record an owner deferral.
Decide available_hours (TC-20..22): build per-person capacity or record team capacity as the accepted substitute.
Reports: decide metric_snapshot (RP-9) or record live-only as an owner decision; add drillItems to the 12 reports without it (RP-12); add export for custom reports and widgets (RP-10).

KB: add callout and work-item-reference insertion and an owner picker to the editor using Kaneo/packages/ui Tiptap pieces (KB-5..7); add tests for related selection and popular/recent ordering (KB-15, KB-16).

Service management: add a portal release-notes surface (REL-5); decide whether CAB becomes default and how the low-risk pre-approval edge is authored (CH-2, CH-3); snapshot cycles that end by date for velocity (CY-9).
